mechanism: Rilpivirine is a non-nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitor that requires acidic gastric pH for absorption; estradiol-containing oral contraceptives may reduce rilpivirine exposure through altered gastric pH or enterohepatic circulation effects, potentially compromising antiretroviral efficacy.
action: Monitor for adequate antiretroviral response and consider alternative contraceptive methods (IUD, barrier methods, or progestin-only options) or ensure adequate rilpivirine dosing; if combined use is necessary, separate administration timing and monitor viral load.
